text:
Ethan: Did someone just swoop my waiver pickup?? :rage:
Priya: @Ethan ? I thought you had auto-claim on this week.
Ethan: I DID but it was set to lowest priority? how does that happen.
Liam: @Ethan you probably changed it while juggling snacks at the kitchen table. :popcorn:
Zoe: Wait are we bribing waivers with snacks now? I can bring empanadas for a roster trade.
Sam: Not me — I was asleep. Draft-bot: waiver processed: `Pickup: Marcus Green (FA) -> Sam`, priority: 1.
Ethan: @Sam you ninja. When did you even log in? :eyes:
Sam: 03:12am. Couldn't sleep, saw the alert, grabbed him. No regrets. :coffee:
Priya: lol @Sam the 3am waiver king. Also FYI I turned autopick ON because of the baby monitor.
Ethan: Great. So how do I get Marcus back without selling my soul?
Liam: Offer Zoe a snack platter and maybe one of your bench RBs. That's market rate. :money_with_wings:
Zoe: I want empanadas, guac, and a selfish pickup (aka an RB). Terms: 12 hours.
Ethan: Tempting. Which bench RB do you want? `J. Carter` or `D. Holmes`?
Zoe: Carter. He has the good bye-week coverage.
Sam: I'll trade Carter for a box of empanadas + a GIF of my victory dance. Deal? :tada:
Ethan: Deal but GIF must be premium. No low-res dancing.
Priya: Also can we have a poll: who’s allowed to autopick for the office pool next week? :ballot_box:
Liam: +1 make rules before midnight Sunday. No 3am ninjas.
Zoe: Poll idea: `Allow autopick: [Yes, No, Only with permission]`
draft-bot: poll created: "Autopick rules for next week" — react :thumbsup: for Yes, :thumbsdown: for No, :eyes: for Only with permission.
Sam: Voting with my thumbs as soon as I finish the victory coffee. :coffee: :thumbsup:
Ethan: Also shoutout to @Priya for babysitting my lineup. Couldn’t have done it without you. :raised_hands:
Priya: Haha minor crisis averted. Also empanadas accepted. Where do we drop them?
Zoe: Kitchen counter, label them. No one steals food on my watch.
Liam: Someone should record the GIF trade ceremony for posterity.
Ethan: Will upload the premium GIF in #random-gifs once trade is sealed.
Sam: Trade sealed. Empanadas incoming.
Ethan: Closing thread: lesson learned — check autopick priority and bribe scale. :face_with_hand_over_mouth:
Zoe: Also reminder: playoffs soon. Keep bench warmers insured.
draft-bot: reminder: playoffs start in 3 weeks. Good luck! :four_leaf_clover:
